To remove the icons:
 - use "disable apps"
 - reboot or use the "crash everything" tool
 - add apps of your choosing into the now empty space
 - optionally, use "enable apps" if you still want to launch those apps elsewhere (you may have to reboot again after this)

Note: after re-enabling the apps and rebooting again, any unused space on the taskbar will be re-populated with the bloatware app icons.

Disables the blue wall that marks the size of your play space, also called the \"Boundary\". Useful for testing and debugging.\n\nWARNING: This will allow you to walk into walls without warning, which can be very painful.

Before pairing, you need to enable development settings:
 - go to: Android Settings > (scroll down) > About headset > (scroll down)
 - tap "Build number" repeatedly at least 7 times until development settings gets enabled
 - you may have to enter your pin, it's the same one you use on the lock screen

After doing this, try starting pairing again.

If you have another way of pairing, select "ignore" to skip this check.
To start pairing, go to: Developer options > Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code
